errorPattern: needs a `<@catch>` to handle errors or a `<@placeholder>` to show while its content is pending
reason: stock Marko 6.4.4 refuses a <try> with neither <@catch> nor <@placeholder> at compile time ("The `<try>` tag needs a `<@catch>` to handle errors or a `<@placeholder>` to show while its content is pending. Without either it has no effect, so render its content directly."; probed with packages/stock-marko, @marko/compiler 5.42.11 + marko 6.4.4). Marko 6.3.51 rendered it. @mxlang/core now raises the same error (builtin-tags.ts, tryTransform) on every target, so both sides throw. Not a divergences.md row: MX rejects what Marko rejects.
